decisions.reason: The candidate's same-message MODIFY already captures the provisioned wallet, NFT and reward storage, and reward-access flow; the Transak conversion-and-mint detail does not require another state change.
The same-message INTRODUCE already establishes automatic wallet provisioning during a Transak fiat mint. The source change adds no necessary independent change to the wallet-provisioning mechanism.
Automatic initiation of a mint after Transak conversion adds a payment-path behavior but does not change the NFT ebook's unlimited primary-mint product or supply model.
The Transak conversion-and-mint sequence does not change any primary-sale allocation, prize-pool recipient, or fiat-fee treatment.
The source mentions the existing $15 price but does not change the mint price or its no-hidden-fees condition.
The post-payment Transak mint behavior does not change tipping availability, amounts, customization, or placement.
The existing same-message FAQ MODIFY already requires explaining that Transak converts fiat and mints the NFT to the created wallet, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The Transak conversion-and-mint behavior does not change the certificate email's read action or confirmation contents.
The fiat post-payment flow does not change the reader's default mode, PDF.js technology, or access points.
The Transak conversion-and-mint behavior does not change offline-download availability, labeling, or presentation.
Automatic initiation of an NFT mint after fiat conversion does not change the prize-win notification trigger or email delivery channel.
The client directs the Transak conversion-and-mint explanation to the new FAQ section and does not require corresponding changes to the About page copy.
